member.name: T:Foundgine.Abstractions.FieldIdJsonConverter
member.summary: Lets be used both as an ordinary JSON value and as a dictionary key (e.g. IReadOnlyDictionary<FieldId, object?> results returned from mutation execution). System.Text.Json's default object converter cannot serialize a struct as a property name unless it explicitly overrides ReadAsPropertyName/WriteAsPropertyName, so without this converter any dictionary keyed by FieldId throws NotSupportedException the moment it is serialized.
